title: Genomic Analysis of Pediatric Bone Tumors
brief_summary: To determine whether gene expression analysis of primary tumor samples before and after chemotherapy are predictive of long-term survival in pediatric patients with bone sarcomas (Ewings sarcoma (ES) and Osteosarcoma(OS)).
raw_criteria: Inclusion Criteria:All patients with bone x-rays suggestive of a malignant bone tumor Exclusion Criteria:Patients with a known diagnosis of cancer.
study_population: All patients with bone x-rays suggestive of a malignant bone tumor
